write_access_denied.title: Airkey API key has no write access
write_access_denied.description: The Airkey API key for '{title}' rejected a write request (HTTP 403). Free/read-only Airkey contracts can only be used for monitoring; creating, updating or deleting data requires a production API key with write access. Upgrade your Airkey Cloud Interface license or use a key that has been granted write permissions.
